title: Diver sucked into a giant grouper's mouth

tellings.quote: curious so it came up behind him and it opened its mouth and he got sucked backwards into this fish mouth

plain: The story goes that in the 1960s, a diver working at an oil platform in the Gulf of Mexico was approached from behind by a huge, curious grouper fish. It opened its mouth and sucked him in backwards. Joe McMoneagle, a guest known as a former psychic spy for the US government, tells it as something he heard from someone else, and he does not name the diver in the telling.
